# Ayman Nassar, CMA

> Keynote speaker, investor-storyteller and stand-up comedian based in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. Certified Management Accountant and Senior Internal Auditor at ArcelorMittal Dofasco. Finished the 270 km Marathon des Sables across the Sahara in April 2026, the fourth Egyptian in history to do so.

## Talks
- 270 Kilometres: What the Sahara Taught Me About Resilience (keynote, 45 to 60 minutes plus Q&A) for corporate teams, universities and conferences.
- How to Make Money in the Egyptian Stock Market: a storytelling session on dividend-focused investing on the EGX and Boursa Kuwait, for Egyptian and diaspora audiences. Not financial advice. Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zqgNuwevZhs
- Stand-up comedy: club spots, showcases and hosted events in Hamilton and the GTA.

## Press and recognition
- CBC Fresh Air feature, March 2026
- The Hamilton Spectator feature, March 2026
- Honoured by Egypt's Minister of Youth and Sports in Cairo, 20 May 2026
